info.title: Masjid Connect API
info.description: Public API (`/api/v1`, api-public) and admin API (`/api/admin`, api-admin). Errors: RFC 9457 problem+json.

get.summary: Liveness, dependency pings and build version
Public settings: Hijri offset, banners, legal versions, grievance officer

post.summary: Register a device (Turnstile); the secret is returned once

get.summary: What the server stores about this device (05 §4)

patch.summary: Change language, brother/sister choice or accepted privacy version

delete.summary: Clear all data: delete the device, its follows and Ameens

put.summary: Store this device’s push subscription (an allow-listed push service only — 04 §6) and turn push on

delete.summary: Remove this device’s push subscription (notifications off)

get.summary: Follow code → masjid summary (uniform 404 for anything not active)
The server copy of this device’s follows

patch.summary: Mute or unmute push for a followed masjid

get.summary: Content version and status of up to 20 masjids
A masjid’s profile, raw timings, special dates and Ramadan settings (immutable per version)
Published items of a masjid, newest first (≤ 30 per page; immutable per version)
A masjid’s Ruqyah entries under their headings, library content expanded (A19; immutable per version)
A published item with its library content and masjid (immutable per version)

post.summary: Say Ameen on a dua request (once per device; idempotent)

get.summary: Live Ameen counts of up to 30 dua requests (kept out of immutable responses)
A verified library entry
Active notice templates in all four languages
Link-preview tags for a follow link
Link-preview tags for a shared post
Liveness, dependency pings and build version
Read an invite without using it (uniform 404 when invalid)
The signed-in admin, their masjids and whether the undertaking must be accepted
Own live sessions

delete.summary: Sign out on every device, this one included
Sign out one of your own sessions (204 even for unknown ids)

post.summary: Accept the current admin undertaking (B2)

get.summary: Own passkeys (labels and dates only)

post.summary: Link to add a passkey on another device (72 h, one use; needs a step-up in the last 5 minutes)
Sign out this session

put.summary: Save this phone's push subscription for the signed-in admin's alerts (an allow-listed push service only)

delete.summary: Stop alerts on this phone (removes the signed-in admin's subscription for this endpoint)

post.summary: Passkey creation options for an invite (uniform 404 when the invite is invalid)
Store the new passkey, use the invite and sign in (one transaction)
Passkey request options for a discoverable login (challenge bound to a 5-minute cookie)
Verify a passkey assertion and sign in (new session)
Passkey request options to confirm a sensitive action (bound to this session)
Verify a passkey assertion of the signed-in admin: rotates the session and opens the 5-minute window

get.summary: Followers, items published and Ameens in the last 7 days (B3 header)
Today's notifying publishes against the masjid's daily push quota (IST day)
The masjid's notifications, newest first, with how many were sent and failed (T4.5)
Location, calculation settings and raw timings — resolved on the phone (today strip, editor)

put.summary: Save the five prayers and Jumu’ah at once (If-Match: "<rev>"; 412 when someone saved in between)

get.summary: The saved timings resolved for one IST day, as musallis see them
Special dates from 30 days ago onwards, by date (B11)

post.summary: Add a special date (1–5 times, within 400 days; optionally notify followers)

patch.summary: Replace a special date (a label or note left out is removed)

delete.summary: Delete a special date (followers stop seeing it after their next version poll)

post.summary: Upload a photo (≤ 10 MB; JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF by content): sanitized, re-encoded, then stored

get.summary: Notice templates an admin may pick (active, not system) in all four languages (B5)

post.summary: Publish a notice — a template with its params or own text; optionally notify followers (B5)
Publish today's hadith or ayah — a verified library entry and an optional note (B6)
Publish a dua request — message, optional private name, a verified dua, an inteqal janaza (B7)

get.summary: My Posts: every status, newest first, with the edit window and the If-Match value (B12)

patch.summary: Edit a post within 24 h of publishing (If-Match: "<updatedAt>"; 412 when someone saved in between; never notifies)

delete.summary: Delete a post (followers stop seeing it after their next version poll; kept 180 days, then purged)

get.summary: Masjid Profile: names in four scripts, place, photo, the Hijri adjustment (B13)

patch.summary: Set the masjid's Hijri adjustment (-2 to +2; null = the app's) - no other field can change here

post.summary: Upload a voice note (up to 25 MB and 10 minutes; Ogg, WebM, MP4/M4A/AAC/3GP, MP3 or WAV by content) with its waveform
Change the masjid photo (up to 10 MB; JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF by content; sanitized and re-encoded)
Ask the Super Admin to change the names, area or address (a note on their dashboard)

get.summary: Ramadan mode (start/end, null when off) and the Sehri / Iftar precautions

put.summary: Save Ramadan mode (start ≤ end, at most 30 days; both null = off) and the precautions

get.summary: Verified Content Library entries: kind, category and tag chips, search (B6/B7)
Today's hadith/ayah suggestion — same all day, not one published in the last 60 days — and whether one of the kind went out today (B6)
"Adhkar after salah": on/off and the verified dhikr entries in order (B16)

put.summary: Replace the "Adhkar after salah" set — verified dhikr entries only, ≤ 30, in order (followers see it after their next version poll)

get.summary: Ruqyah entries in the masjid’s order, library content expanded (B15)

post.summary: Add a Ruqyah entry at the end: a verified library entry, the masjid’s own text, or a recording with the ownership tick (≤ 50)

patch.summary: Replace a Ruqyah entry (its place stays; a title, instruction or reference left out is removed)

delete.summary: Delete a Ruqyah entry (followers stop seeing it after their next version poll)

put.summary: Put the Ruqyah entries in a new order — every active entry exactly once

get.summary: Ilm contacts, brothers’ first, each audience in the masjid’s order (B17)

post.summary: Add an Ilm contact — only with `consentConfirmed: true` (≤ 10)

patch.summary: Replace an Ilm contact (consent confirmed again; a role or topics left out is removed)

delete.summary: Remove an Ilm contact (followers stop seeing it after their next version poll)

get.summary: UPI details shown to followers now, and the change request in progress (B8)

post.summary: Ask to set or change the UPI details — live only after Super Admin approval and the hold (04 R1)

get.summary: Donation drives — active, then completed, then closed (B8)

post.summary: Start a donation drive — needs the masjid's active UPI details; at most 3 active (00 §4.3)

patch.summary: Edit a donation drive — title, description, cover, end date; the target only upward (audited)

post.summary: "Update amount": what the masjid reports received (a history row each time; notify optional)
Mark a donation drive completed (it stays visible until it closes)

get.summary: Weekly chanda — settings and the latest weeks, newest first (B9)

put.summary: Save a week's chanda total — the masjid's week-start day, not a future week; one feed item per week

patch.summary: "Show chanda to followers" (mirrored onto every week) and the day the week starts

get.summary: Pending activations, masjid counts, passkey clone alerts and admins' change requests (C1)
List and search masjids (C2)

post.summary: Create a masjid (pending until activated)

get.summary: Masjid page: profile, followers, admins (C2)

patch.summary: Edit a masjid profile (bumps its content version)
Set the masjid’s daily notification quota

post.summary: Activate (needs an active admin who accepted the undertaking, and all five jamaat times)
★ Suspend with a reason
★ Unsuspend with a reason
Create a masjid admin and their one-time invite link

get.summary: Admins of a masjid

post.summary: ★ New invite link (closes the previous one of the same purpose)
★ Sign the admin out everywhere
★ Revoke all passkeys (and sessions) of the admin

delete.summary: ★ Remove the admin from a masjid

get.summary: ★ Decrypt and show the admin’s phone (audited)
Global settings (C10)

post.summary: ★ Pause or resume every notification (kill switch, C10 — jobs wait and continue on resume)
A test alert to your own subscribed phones (staging and local only — T4.6)

get.summary: Audit log (C11)
★ Audit log as CSV (same filters, at most 10 000 rows)
Content Library review list — every status, filters and search (C8)
One Content Library entry in full, any status (C8 review)

patch.summary: Edit an entry — changing its text sends a verified entry back to draft (DECISIONS #108)

post.summary: Check a Content Library file: row errors and duplicates; nothing is written
★ Import a Content Library file as draft — all entries, or none when anything is wrong
Verify a draft entry (records who verified it); admins may pick it from now on
Retire an entry (final): no longer selectable or shown

get.summary: Every notice template, any status (C9)

post.summary: Create a notice template — always a draft until its translations are reviewed

get.summary: One notice template (C9 editor)

patch.summary: Edit a template or move its status (activation needs reviewed translations)

post.summary: Add the missing starter templates (00 §4.3) as drafts; existing keys are left as they are

get.summary: Open UPI change requests — pending and on hold — oldest first, with the live details (C4)

post.summary: ★ Approve a UPI change — it goes live after the hold (PAYMENT_HOLD_MINUTES, ≥ 24 h in production)
Turn down a UPI change — while pending, or during the hold to stop it (DECISIONS #146)
